name: Typeform Problem Report Routing
description: Log every completed Typeform problem report in Google Sheets, then send severe reports to Slack and other reports by email.
requirements: Typeform Personal Access Token, a form with Email, Name, Severity and Problem questions, and a public HTTPS webhook callback
Google Sheets account with edit access to a spreadsheet containing a Problems sheet with Email, Name, Severity, Problem headers in A1:D1
Slack account allowed to post to the configured channel
Public IMAP/SMTP mailbox with email and app password for Open Flow; configured recipient and corresponding SMTP sender in n8n
